video.caption: Recorded on the live site: a sample with trailing commas is repaired and passes schema validation, then a schema-mismatch sample is caught and fails validation.

shots.alt: SchemaGuard landing page: Turn messy LLM output into validated JSON, with a repair note showing a trailing comma removed
The validation workspace after repairing trailing commas: raw output on the left, the repaired JSON that matches the schema on the right
A schema-mismatch sample: the JSON is syntactically fine, but SchemaGuard reports Validation failed because the fields don’t match the schema
